dogecoin.text: And now Dogecoin, where lots of coins from 2014 are still untouched. https://t.co/na6R0rBbd0

One possible reason why BTC was created with "only" 21 quadrillion satoshis: it fits in a signed long (63 bits).

Dogecoin has such a high supply it overflows a Java long and will even overflow 64 bits in the future due to tail inflation.

Dogecoin nodes are quite slow right now.

Given it split off Bitcoin's code, this puts in perspective the amount of work that went into optimizing Bitcoin Core in the past few years.
